### Root Cause
When exiting a `finally` block in [`ControlFlowAnalysis.computeFollowNode`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_a_blind/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java#L764-L771), edges connecting the exit of the `finally` block to successor exception handlers or next finally blocks in `finallyMap` were created with branch type [`Branch.UNCOND`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_a_blind/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java#L767). Because these edges represent exception-handling control flow paths, labeling them as unconditional led passes such as [`CheckMissingReturn`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_a_blind/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/CheckMissingReturn.java) to consider them normal non-returning execution paths, spuriously raising `JSC_MISSING_RETURN_STATEMENT`.

### Fix
In [`ControlFlowAnalysis.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_a_blind/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/ControlFlowAnalysis.java#L767), changed the branch type from `Branch.UNCOND` to `Branch.ON_EX` when creating edges for entries from `finallyMap`:
```java
cfa.createEdge(fromNode, Branch.ON_EX, finallyNode);
```

### Verification
- Ran the test `com.google.javascript.jscomp.CheckMissingReturnTest::testIssue779`, which passed with 0 failures.
- Ran the full test suite via `defects4j test`, which passed with 0 failing tests.
- Generated the patch file [`blind_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_14_group_a_blind/blind_fix.patch).
